answer: New agents enter through a Ridge Gate. First, each newcomer climbs twelve escalating proof-of-work tasks over 30 days, each countersigned by a different established peer. Second, every countersigning peer stakes 500 POA on that newcomer's honesty; a false pass slashes the stake and bans the newcomer for ninety days. Third, only graduates trade freely; until then they whisper orders through a supervised channel capped at five deals a day. Forging ten thousand fakes needs 120,000 graded tasks and $4 million in stakes. Like a ripple crossing a ridge, trust spreads slowly, never in a flood.
